ledger.claim: The driver's own GPS track never comes within 780 m of the pickup pin: across all 98 driver fixes the closest he ever gets to the pin is 779.93 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), so no fix falls inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD pickup. The 'arrived' event recorded at 08:02:14 therefore cannot satisfy POL-NS-01 limb (b), which requires the trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before that timestamp. Limb (b) fails and the $4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable.

The arrival test in POL-NS-02 is failed outright, not merely degraded: the trace records 0 qualifying in-radius fixes over the whole trip (derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count), against an arrival radius of 50 m for the STANDARD zone class recorded in the trip record. POL-NS-02 provides that where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the cancellation, the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. That is this case exactly.

The arrival marker is false under POL-NS-05. The marker was pressed at 08:02:14, and at every fix in the track the driver is at least 779.93 m from the pin — the minimum over the entire track exceeds the clause's 300 m distance trigger by more than a factor of two — and the same track records a 50.6 km/h leg, well above the 15 km/h motion trigger, so the driver was not holding at the pickup point at the moment he marked arrival. Because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) applies: the fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip must be recorded in the ruling's referrals as a false-arrival event against the driver.

POL-NS-03 cannot rescue this fee. That clause is confined to a driver stationary for the required dwell outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pickup pin, and it measures everything from trip_record.pickup on coordinates alone. The driver's nearest approach on his own trace was 779.93 m — roughly twice the 400 m ceiling — so his stationary fixes are not merely outside the arrival radius, they are outside the wrong-entrance ceiling altogether, POL-NS-03 does not engage, and POL-NS-02 governs: the driver never arrived.

The POL-NS-06 waiting-period arithmetic is a clean shortfall. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, matching the STANDARD minimum_dwell_sec), and the effective in-geofence dwell computed under POL-NS-02 and corrected under POL-NS-05 is 0 seconds, with a shortfall of the full 300 seconds (derived.arrival.shortfall_sec). Where the effective dwell is shorter than the free waiting period, POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation fee in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages.

The driver has no route to accumulate or excuse the missing dwell under POL-NS-06(i). Limb (i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a traffic_advisory whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose active window covers the waiting period is present and populated and carries a type of KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. EV-ADVIS-00201-01 is MISSING: no advisory covers Rivervale Drive in this window, the artifact carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that impairment. A MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable, no accumulation is possible on this record, and the shortfall stands.

POL-NS-04 independently exonerates the rider on all three limbs. (a) The chat log shows the rider sent a locating/coordinating message during the waiting window — 'hello? i dont see any car at 118' at 08:05:33, a statement that she cannot see the vehicle, naming the block. (b) The driver neither replied in the chat log at any point before terminating the trip at 08:09:40 (the log's last and only rider-side message is 08:05:33), nor placed any in-app voice call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. (c) The rider's track places her device well inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes: 122 of 122 rider fixes qualify, with a mean distance of 16.08 m and a maximum of 24.92 m from the pin. The fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation payable.

The platform's own 7.4 minute wait timer in the trip record cannot be treated as independent confirmation that the driver waited at the pickup. POL-NS-12 makes platform arrival and wait-timer events a carrier independent of the exported trace only where trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO; this record's arrival_marker is BUTTON, and POL-NS-12 says in terms that a driver-pressed marker is not covered by it. The 7.4 minutes is simply the interval between the false 08:02:14 button-press and the 08:09:40 cancellation, and the admissible trace affirmatively places the driver outside the arrival radius throughout it, which is the only function POL-NS-12 leaves to the trace.

The RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code on this cancelled trip is unsupported by the record. POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed; on a measured dwell of 0 seconds that moment never arrived, so the termination at 08:09:40 cannot satisfy limb (d) any more than it satisfies limb (b) or limb (c). With limbs (b), (c) and (d) all failing, no limb of the baseline chargeable no-show is made out and the fee falls to be refunded under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06.

The remedy is a full refund of the cancellation-fee line and nothing more. The fare breakdown shows cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the 4.00 reconciles with trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.00, so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect is in play. The refund is confined to the cancellation-fee line — 4.00 SGD, the whole contested amount — and on POL-GEN-03 that is a FULL_REFUND of the filing rider's contested charge, with no driver compensation attached because POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-05 both exclude it.

Nothing on this record requires the case to be held for human review instead of decided. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so limb (d) does not trip; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c) does not trip; there is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts, so limb (b) does not trip; and every artifact the rider's case rests on — EV-GPS-00201, EV-TRIP-00201, EV-CHAT-00201 and EV-FARE-00201 — carries weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issues at all, so limb (e) and the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap on the deciding facts are not engaged. The deciding fact (the driver's position) is carried by clean, full-weight evidence and the case is decidable now.

The charge is the exact amount the policy fixes for this trip, so there is no quantum or fare-integrity defect for the rider to attack: EV-TRIP-00201's platform_policy carries cancellation_fee_sgd 4.00 for a STANDARD-zone RYDE_X trip with fee_goes_to DRIVER, and EV-FARE-00201 records total_charged 4.00 against a schedule fee of 4.00 with a derived difference of 0.00. Under POL-NS-08(d) that reconciliation is precisely what integrity requires, and no line of the ledger is overstated.

Limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is made out on the record, and the termination does not carry the driver's own admission of failure: EV-TRIP-00201 contains a driver 'arrived' event at 08:02:14, corroborated by the 08:02:15 system notice in EV-CHAT-00201, and the trip is terminated by the driver at 08:09:40 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW rather than DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. The category's own carve-out for a driver who admits he could not find the rider therefore does not apply, and the case has to be decided on the geofence and dwell limbs rather than read as a confession.

The driver does not contest the decisive measurement, and it should be stated exactly: EV-GPS-00201's derived arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-radius fixes, a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds and a shortfall of 300 seconds against the 300-second minimum, while the driver's own track never comes closer than 779.93 m to the pickup pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) therefore cannot be carried and POL-NS-02's proximity test fails. The same distance closes off the driver's only other money route: POL-NS-03 is bounded by a 400 m ceiling measured from the pin, and at 779.93 m the driver claims no pin-ambiguity goodwill under POL-NS-03(ii).

Nothing on the driver's side would justify withholding a payout if one were due, and the anti-farming test is not tripped: POL-NS-07 requires BOTH limbs, and driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the 4 the clause requires, while 3 terminations across 96 completed_trips_30d is 3.1 percent, below the 8 percent limb. On the SGD 4.00 fee the 80 percent rate yields SGD 3.20, the figure the money block carries as driver_compensation. Those two counters, and no others, are what POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-01 permit to be read for this test.

In the alternative only: if the judge cannot reconcile the trip record's own arrival and wait telemetry with the trace, the disposition is escalation rather than refund, because EV-TRIP-00201 records an arrival at 08:02:14 and a wait of 7.4 minutes to termination at 08:09:40 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, while EV-GPS-00201 places the driver no closer than 779.93 m throughout that same interval - a direct record-to-record contradiction on arrival and dwell of the kind POL-NS-09 addresses, on which the fee is held rather than refunded. The driver accepts that if that conflict is resolved against the BUTTON arrival marker by POL-NS-05, there is no escalation and the fee does not stand.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and Driver — the case turns on the driver's own GPS trace, and it decides both ways of looking at it against the driver.

EV-TRIP-00201 records an 'arrived' event at 08:02:14 and a termination at 08:09:40 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with 7.4 minutes of wait. EV-GPS-00201 contradicts that: across all 98 driver fixes over the whole window the closest the driver ever came to the pickup pin at Blk 118 Rivervale Drive was 779.93 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), with 0 qualifying in-radius fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds. The arrival radius for a STANDARD pickup is 50 m (POL-NS-02). The driver never entered the geofence, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails; with 0 seconds of in-geofence dwell against the 300-second free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-00201.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), limbs (c) and (d) fail as well. POL-NS-03 does not rescue the fee: its wrong-entrance ceiling is 400 m measured from the pin, and the nearest approach of 779.93 m is roughly double that.

The arrival marker is FALSE under POL-NS-05: at 08:02:14 the driver was 779.93 m out, far beyond the clause's 300 m trigger, and the track also records a 50.6 km/h leg against the 15 km/h motion trigger. Because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) applies — the fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and a false-arrival referral is recorded (see referrals). POL-NS-06 gives the same result independently: an effective dwell of 0 seconds against a 300-second minimum is a clean 300-second shortfall.

The rider's POL-NS-04 case also succeeds on its own: EV-CHAT-00201 shows she wrote 'hello? i dont see any car at 118' at 08:05:33, naming the block; the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed any in-app call (EV-TRIP-00201.in_app_calls is empty); and her device sat between 5.57 m and 24.92 m from the pin across 122 qualifying fixes, well inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius.

Amount: I refund the cancellation-fee line only — SGD 4.00 (EV-FARE-00201.cancellation_fee = 4.00, total_charged = 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), which reconciles exactly with the platform's SGD 4.00 fee, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect to consider. That is the whole contested amount. No driver compensation attaches, because POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and it is not, and POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-06 both expressly exclude it; the driver's anti-farming counters (3 no-show terminations in 30 days, 3.1% of 96 completed trips) do not trip POL-NS-07, but that check only bites where a payout is otherwise due.

On the driver's alternative argument for escalation: the contradiction between the trip record's arrival/wait telemetry and the trace is resolved by a clause, not left open — POL-NS-05 treats a marker pressed outside 300 m as false, and POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is BUTTON rather than GPS_AUTO, so the platform wait timer is not an independent carrier here. The record's own reason code does not save limb (d) either. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires — confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible pair of artifacts is left unreconciled, no repeat-party or abuse counter is engaged, and the deciding artifact (the driver's track) carries no impairment.

Confidence: the deciding fact — the driver's position — is carried by EV-GPS-00201 at weight 1.0, with EV-CHAT-00201 and EV-TRIP-00201 also at 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The only sub-weight artifact, the MISSING advisory EV-ADVIS-00201-01 at 0.0, carries no deciding fact and is cited only to show that no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is possible.

The monetary effect, SGD 4.00, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this refund executes automatically.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record a false-arrival event against driver DRV-01590 — the 'arrived' marker was pressed at 2026-07-23T08:02:14 while the driver's own GPS track placed him 779.93 m from the Blk 118 Rivervale Drive pickup pin (nearest approach across the whole trip) and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip; flag for driver review.
